To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of multiple antennas is essential for reliable communication in car-to-car scenarios.
the antenna configuration with two pairs of vertically aligned antennas on the roof of the car provides the best performance in the investigated scenario.
the use of MIMO antenna configurations in car-to-car scenarios can significantly improve the communication reliability and thus the safety of the system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation and optimization of antenna configurations for car-to-car systems.
the design of antenna systems for future car-to-car communication applications.
the evaluation of different antenna configurations for car-to-car communication, which is a promising technology for the future.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the antenna configuration consisting of two antennas on each side of the car, one in the middle and one at the back of the car, is most promising in terms of channel quality and achievable communication distance.
the use of MIMO communication in car-to-car systems can increase the achievable communication distance and therefore improve safety in urban scenarios.

the antenna configurations are able to establish a reliable communication link in the considered scenario, but the link is not able to provide a communication distance that would be sufficient to ensure safety.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed antenna configurations can be used to achieve reliable communication in car-to-car scenarios.
the proposed antenna configurations can be used for communication in the considered scenario.
a MIMO antenna setup with antennas placed at the front and rear of the car can provide a reliable and high-capacity link over a communication distance of 100 m.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MIMO communication links with a high channel capacity can be established in car-to-car scenarios, which can be exploited in order to increase the data rate and reliability of the system.
the channel capacity of MIMO systems is significantly increased compared to SISO systems.
a simple MIMO configuration consisting of two antennas mounted on the roof of the car is sufficient for reliable communication.
